hypotheses.statement: Couriers want the cash amount shown before they reach the customer's door.
hypotheses.supportedIf: At least 60% of qualified respondents answer Yes to q3.
hypotheses.refutedIf: Fewer than 40% of qualified respondents answer Yes to q3.

hypotheses.statement: Counting cash at the door is a high-effort step.
hypotheses.supportedIf: The mean effort rating on q4 is 3.5 or more.
hypotheses.refutedIf: The mean effort rating on q4 is under 2.5.

hypotheses.supportedIf: Cash is chosen by more than half of qualified respondents in q5.
hypotheses.refutedIf: Another method is chosen more often than cash in q5.

instrument.intro: This is a five minute survey about collecting cash at the door. There are no right answers.
instrument.consent: Your answers are used only to improve the courier app. You can stop at any time. Do you agree to take part?
instrument.closing: Thank you. Your answers help us decide what the first screen shows.

questions.text: Do you currently deliver parcels as a courier?
How long have you been a courier?
Do you need the cash amount shown before you reach the customer's door?
How much effort does counting cash at the door take?
Which ways do customers pay you?
What is the hardest part of taking payment at the door?
How many cash parcels do you deliver on a normal day?
